landingPage.header: Make smarter decisions with real-world insights.
landingPage.headerDescription: Compare Isuzu trucks against competitors or evaluate ownership costs to understand the full financial picture -- beyond the sticker price.
landingPage.leftDesc: Lower fuel consumption means long-term savings
landingPage.middleDesc: Understand both purchase price and long-term operating expenses
landingPage.centerDesc: Strong residual value keeps your investment working for you even after resale
landingPage.rightDesc: Isuzu's reputation for durability helps reduce unexpected repair costs.

default.titleName: Select an Isuzu Truck to Start
default.subMessage: If you choose a conventional fossil fuel vehicle, a generic comparable alternative may be automatically included for comparison. Change this vehicle by selecting an alternate from the vehicle catalog.
default.alertMessage: If operating multiple trucks over varying distances, consider grouping them into separate sets. You can create additional sets at the end of this setup wizard by clicking Create Scenario.
default.financeTooltip: The finance type shows how you'll pay for the selected trucks. It uses default values based on your choices to estimate the finance costs. You can modify these later in the Financing tab.

modifyDefaultValues.subMessage: Select your first vehicle. If you select a Fossil Fuel vehicle, an EV replacement will be selected for you. You can choose to remove EV chargers from your analysis if they are not relevant to your scenario. If you do not want to include vehicles in your comparison, please create a new project and select a different project type.
modifyDefaultValues.alertMessage: If operating multiple vehicles over varying distances, consider grouping them into separate sets. You can create additional sets at the end of this setup wizard by clicking Create Scenario
modifyDefaultValues.financeTooltip: The finance type shows how you'll pay for the selected trucks. It uses default values based on your choices to estimate the finance costs. You can modify these later in the Financing tab.

addElectricVehicle.subMessage: Select your first vehicle. If you select a vehicle with a gas or diesel engine, an EV equivalent will be selected for you.
addElectricVehicle.alertMessage: Vehicle specifications can be updated using the edit (pencil) icon on the vehicle.  If operating multiple vehicles over varying distances, consider grouping them into separate sets. You can create additional sets at the end of this setup wizard by clicking plus button.
addElectricVehicle.financeTooltip: The finance type represents how you will pay for the vehicles selected. This finance type will assume default values based on your selection to calculate the finance costs. These can be changed later in the Financing tab.
